summary.text: Paul Tudor is a Republican state representative from Rockingham 1 who has served since December 2, 2020, and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
He served in the U.S. Air Force and worked at General Electric.

paragraphs.text: Paul Tudor served in the U.S. Air Force, and his career experience includes leading a jet engine facility design team with General Electric.
He took office in the New Hampshire House on December 2, 2020, succeeding Democrat David Coursin.
